content: अम्बूकृत {%a.%} Sputtered, pronounced indistinctly in shutting the lips, the sound thus remaining as it were in the mouth; uttered while emitting saliva from the mouth. .{@-तम्@} A sputtering noise, the growling of a bear; दधति कुहरभाजामत्र भल्लूकयूनामनुरसितगुरूणि स्त्यानम्बूकृतानि <ls>U. 2. 21</ls>; <ls>Māl. 9. 6</ls>; <ls>Mv. 5. 41</ls>.
